info.sub_ename: THEORY AND SYSTEM OF PROPERTY TAX

description.sub_ename: THEORY AND SYSTEM OF PROPERTY TAX
description.describe_ch: 介紹財產稅基本概念與理論，如財產稅的分類、財產稅的稅基、財產稅的減免、財產稅的管理、財產稅的公平性、財產稅的歸宿等，以及我國現行財產稅制度與政策。探討遺產及贈與稅、土地稅〈契稅、地價稅、土地增值稅〉、房屋稅、契稅等課稅議題。
description.describe_eh: This course provides a framework of property tax theory such as property tax classification, property tax base, property tax exemptions, property tax administration, evaluating property tax equity and property tax incidence ..etc. and introduces our current property tax systems and policies. Discuss Estate and Gift Tax, Land Tax (including Agriculture Land Tax, Land Value Tax, and Land Value Increment Tax), House Tax, and Deeds Tax.

targets.describe_en: Able to understand the current property tax system and regulations in our country

targets.describe_en: Able to apply appropriate property tax theories to explore property tax issues

targets.describe_en: Able to apply property tax laws in conducting tax filing and tax planning
